sloka: निष्पन्दाः तरवः सर्वे निलीना मृग पक्षिणः ।नैशेन तमसा व्याप्ता दिशः च रघुनंदन ॥१-३४-१५॥
transliteration: niṣpandāḥ taravaḥ sarve nilīnā mṛga pakṣiṇaḥ ।naiśena tamasā vyāptā diśaḥ ca raghunaṁdana ॥1-34-15॥

translations.english: O son of the Raghus' the trees stand motionless, with the beasts and birds calm, all directions are pervaded with darkness.
